title: Builder's Utils: <Toolkit> [BTW Addon]
description: A set of useful building tools
body:
# Builder's Utils: <ToolKit> (BTW:CE Addon)
## Goal
The point of this mod is to add useful building tools with different uses and have increasingly advanced features which each tier (iron, diamond, sfs)

## Tools
- Wand = extrude surface
- Trowel = mortar selection
- Scafolding (WIP)
- Wrench (WIP)
- Mixing bag (WIP)
- Builder's boot (WIP)
- Builder's trousers (WIP)
- Builder's vest (WIP
- Builder's hat (WIP)

## Supported languages:
- English
## Dependencies
- [Better Than Wolves CE](https://modrinth.com/mod/btwce)
## Found a bug or have suggestions ?
[Issue tracker](https://github.com/BTW-Community/Builders-Utils-Toolkit/issues)
